title: Jatashankar Mahadev Temple, Junagadh - A Sacred Cave Temple Amid Nature
content:
Jatashankar Mahadev Temple, Junagadh

Nestled at the foothills of Mount Girnar in Junagadh, the Jatashankar Mahadev Temple is one of the most revered and spiritually uplifting sites in Gujarat. Dedicated to Lord Shiva, this ancient cave temple is believed to be the place where Lord Shiva’s hair (Jata) once rested, giving the temple its divine name - Jatashankar.

Surrounded by lush greenery and peaceful surroundings, the temple attracts devotees and nature lovers alike. The gentle sound of flowing water, sacred atmosphere, and echoes of temple bells create an aura of serenity. Many pilgrims visit this temple before beginning their trek to Girnar Hill, seeking blessings from Lord Shiva for strength and protection.

The temple’s natural rock formations, cool interiors, and tranquil environment make it a perfect place for meditation and spiritual reflection. Whether you’re a devotee or a traveler exploring Junagadh, Jatashankar Mahadev Temple offers a truly soul-refreshing experience.

History

The temple holds immense mythological significance and is believed to be centuries old. According to legend, Lord Shiva once rested here during his travels, and the natural spring that flows nearby symbolizes the holy river Ganga. The sacred Shivling inside the cave is said to be self-manifested (Swayambhu), enhancing the temple’s sanctity.

Timings & Entry Fee

  • Timings: 6:00 AM to 8:00 PM (Daily)
  • Entry Fee: No entry fee (Free for all visitors)
  • Best Time to Visit: October to March - pleasant weather for pilgrimage and sightseeing.

How to Reach

  • By Road: The temple is around 5 km from Junagadh city center, easily reachable by auto or cab.
  • By Train: The nearest railway station is Junagadh Junction, about 6 km away.
  • By Air: The closest airport is Rajkot Airport (100 km) from Junagadh.
